subject: general
question:
Which of the following options is the closest approximate value which will come in place of question mark (?) in the following equation?

9.99³.⁰⁰¹ - 5.001².⁹⁹⁹ + 4.997 = ?
solution:
Given:

9.993.001 - 5.0012.999 + 4.997

Concept used:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eafd54de9d9fc295c072d1fa0b8367ee3ed24189b7ad133a51c29266134693c4.png] 

Calculation:

9.993.001 - 5.0012.999 + 4.997

taking the approximate values,

⇒ 10³ - 5³ + 5

⇒ 1000 - 125 + 5

⇒ 875 + 5

⇒ 880

∴ The approximate value is 880.
